data.title: bn-1j8: lost-response recovery without automatic resend
data.description: Review exact range base ea26ff67d53871be7f91e2d4ee1c1527b48ba79b, target d54036bc161362fc0b5a8c22e133c2bbe9075dc7, full-index binary SHA-256 89d2361f03ef20ba889372db9e1e006858a2229dcc74654ab2c4f00bc5c86fb8. Verify durable capture identity before first adapter, exact same-run request-input binding, atomic idempotent reconciliation, observed/none/unknown/conflicting classifications, no automatic resend or new run, zero adapter/Teapot/Evidence/target capability in run show/reconcile, original selector projection, request-key lookup, concurrency safety, and unknown-effects entry priority. Validation under /tmp/bn-1j8-validation: focused d13367b9d365e19f626199f8e2356e484244db2ebed0528bc5976e2b27080ccb; full Store 30df6ac299c51126e22ff674e5355fdb6cf2386e33779f26b3ebf0493c32f8c1; process 629b372247a54c518cf0871381bd4e48b528eb797ff8c3b777e8bb262a54a6aa; effect sink 68da17aebcdb47ca139e638245149b0fdef7e0a02ab2527ce5129decb4993549; SIGKILL 898a1da40630d0418d2c4d80f091486c433103dd976857f6f55147968eed970e; strict Clippy 6c2fee63802ad2a1e5b702d00968d1130f57766cdc0d0d7bd2e380f1e38a3716; serialized offline check dda7c4d5646604168443d2f2343b8e3560fd10d99ec421ec43cb4f8f31b44e81. Qualification limit: frozen pinned Teapot unavailable; no live target traffic, deterministic offline process/effect/SIGKILL witnesses only. risk:high. Please answer: what failure modes exist; what edge cases need validation; how can this be rolled back; what monitoring or alerts are needed; what input validation is needed.

data.body: [risk:high] Do not trust backfilled pre-v14 step outcomes as authenticated adapter evidence. This migration enrolls every historical request key with capture_handle=NULL, but reconcile_run later classifies those existing run_steps as none or observed and may release conflict rows. At the exact base, Store::reconcile_recorded_step was a public API (ea26ff67:crates/scourge-core/src/store/mod.rs:1285-1287), so callers could durably enrich an existing step with not-sent/none or flow:N/observed through the same run.step audit lane; making that writer cfg(test) now does not add provenance to rows already stored. Failure mode: an upgraded caller-authored verdict becomes a trusted recovery result. Edge case: any upgraded keyed run with steps and no v14 capture identity. Rollback/safe repair: keep legacy NULL-handle rows unknown unless an immutable trusted provenance boundary distinguishes production adapter output. Monitoring: flag reconciliation attempts on backfilled rows and any conflict release from them. Input validation: require a post-v14 exact-run capture/provenance binding before classifying none/observed, and add an upgrade regression seeded through the former public route.

[risk:high] Preserve production sent-without-flow evidence as EFFECT_UNKNOWN. execute_step legitimately persists DispatchEvidence::NoFlow as instrument_reference=sent:no-flow, effects=unknown, plus a missing placeholder whose flow_id is null (rounds.rs:1783-1805 and 1894-1896). This loop rejects that placeholder as CONFLICTING_RUN before reaching the intended sent:no-flow branch; and the later nonempty-flows condition can upgrade a mixed sent:no-flow step to observed. Failure modes: a legitimate lost response cannot reconcile, or a multi-action unknown is falsely reported observed. Edge cases: one NoFlow placeholder, NoFlow before/after a retained flow, NotSent plus later action, replay and concurrent reconciliation. Rollback: the current false-conflict transaction rolls back, but a false-observed commit needs corrective state repair. Monitoring: alert on CONFLICTING_RUN with sent:no-flow/null-flow and on unknown-to-observed transitions containing missing flows. Input validation: model missing placeholders as authenticated unknown evidence and make any sent:no-flow/missing action dominate the aggregate; test using the actual execution-produced row.

[risk:high] Fence reconciliation against a still-live verifier before finalizing or releasing its conflicts. This immediate SQLite transaction proves only durable state; it acquires no execution flock and establishes neither process death nor terminal ownership. If run reconcile lands after execute_step has persisted an intent or early observed step, it sets the run finalized and can release conflict rows, while the already-authorized ExecutionStore can continue target dispatches because record_step_inner/ensure_keyed_execution_eligible has no finalized-state fence (store/mod.rs:1307-1316, 2931-2948). Failure modes: recovery reports a terminal result while target traffic continues; an early observed step can release durable conflicts before later effects/cleanup are known. Edge cases: reconcile before first dispatch, between actions, after first observed step, and simultaneous crash. Rollback: keep the transaction unchanged unless exclusive execution ownership or a durable stopped/dead fence is established. Monitoring: flag run.step writes after run.reconcile and reconcile against active lock owners. Input validation: require the same exclusive run/conflict lock protocol or a monotonic terminal handoff, then regression-test reconciliation racing a live writer.

[risk:medium] Preserve the accepted selector when writer opening fails after the passive recovery read. The prior RunRecovery is successfully resolved at lines 97-104, but open_coordination_writer failure takes generic workspace_failure here, dropping the exact run_id, request_key and optional capture_handle and advising generic status rather than the safe effects-free run show <run>. Route this post-resolution failure through a prior-aware projector and add a regression that forces writer-open or schema/open failure after successful recovery.

[risk:medium] Do not limit cross-run flow collision checks to one engagement without an authenticated instrument namespace. Teapot flow IDs are issued by the bound runtime, and two engagements can share that runtime/project; this query ignores a copied flow/reference already attributed to another engagement and can accept it as observed. The acceptance requires cross-run evidence to be CONFLICTING_RUN. Either check all runs in the workspace store or bind each run durably to an exact runtime/capture namespace and compare within that namespace; add a two-engagement shared-runtime regression.

[risk:medium] Establish that the persisted capture handle belongs to this exact run before the first adapter call. Evidence::capture verifies the command id and case, but capture_reference does not check the reply external_run_id (evidence/capture.rs:73-102, 294-304); run_recovery also permits the same handle on multiple runs. A qualified but wrong-run or duplicated reply can therefore be durably bound and displayed as this run recovery identity. Validate the returned/recovered capture against the exact external run and enforce handle ownership uniqueness before persistence; add wrong-run and duplicate-handle no-traffic regressions.

data.reason: BLOCK at exact target d54036bc161362fc0b5a8c22e133c2bbe9075dc7. Independently verified full-index binary SHA-256 89d2361f03ef20ba889372db9e1e006858a2229dcc74654ab2c4f00bc5c86fb8 and all supplied validation hashes. Six open anchored findings remain: (1) v14 backfills legacy rows that could have been caller-enriched through the formerly public reconcile_recorded_step API, then trusts them as none/observed and can release conflicts; (2) the classifier rejects the production sent:no-flow plus null-flow placeholder as CONFLICTING_RUN and can falsely observe mixed unknown evidence; (3) reconciliation lacks an execution-ownership/death fence and can finalize/release conflicts while the live authorized verifier continues dispatching; (4) post-resolution writer-open failure drops the exact recovery selector and safe show advice; (5) cross-run collision checks ignore other engagements without a durable runtime namespace; (6) the newly persisted capture handle is not verified as exact-run/unique before adapters. Risk-high failure modes, edge cases, rollback, monitoring, and input-validation requirements are recorded in th-fgc9h4, th-2oou4e and th-3doo7e. Independent offline reruns passed the production NoFlow shape test and 5/5 existing reconciliation tests, demonstrating the missing end-to-end coverage rather than closing these findings. The pinned Teapot remains unavailable; deterministic evidence is sufficient to establish the blockers, so no live traffic is needed or authorized.

data.body: [risk:high] The lease excludes a live owner, but reconciliation still does not durably fence the capture-to-first-intent crash window. At recovery.rs:120-159, an exact trusted run with a persisted capture and zero steps leaves changed=false, writes no run.reconcile event, and stays declared. Once the reconciler drops the lease, claim_verification_conflicts can reopen the same exact claim and execution_store sees reconciled_run=false, so the original run can later write its first step and dispatch after run reconcile already returned EFFECT_UNKNOWN with read-only show advice. This is reachable because rounds.rs:853-858 persists the capture before start-observation handling and before execute_step writes its intent at 1710. Failure mode: target traffic occurs after an allegedly terminal passive recovery; edge cases are SIGKILL or capture/start-observation failure before the first step, followed by same-key replay or a late writer; rollback/safe repair is to commit a monotonic run.reconcile fence even for zero-step unknown runs while retaining conflicts; monitoring should reject and flag every run.step or execution admission after any reconciliation attempt; input validation/regression should kill after capture persistence but before the first step, assert EFFECT_UNKNOWN plus a committed fence, and prove every later prepare/step/dispatch is refused. The existing live_execution_lease test intentionally skips its post-drop reconciliation assertions for the before-first-dispatch case, so it does not cover this window.

[risk:medium] Accept the legitimate cleanup-action partial write instead of classifying it as conflicting evidence. execute_step deliberately persists exact C-flow references at rounds.rs:1868-1873 before it writes the step's terminal instrument_reference/effects at 1894-1896. A SIGKILL in that documented ordering leaves a trusted production step with effects=None and nonempty exact flows; this branch returns CONFLICTING_RUN even though the evidence is neither malformed nor cross-run. Reconcile that state conservatively from the established flows and unresolved cleanup (retaining conflicts as needed), and add a kill-point regression between the flow-bearing step commit and terminal step update.

LGTM at exact target 191f466942c7e599b9e49e4e08ddf88b8e7d09bc. Independently verified full-range SHA-256 e9077b063d317af6e50419c5561e75f7e56f49dce0363c1b461bf300d9a00ac9 and repair-only SHA-256 d8008f87f2208fe542217b6282d1f7ad346f9d37cbd60312cfe2de987194106f. All seven threads are genuinely resolved. The capture-only trusted crash now atomically commits a finalized EFFECT_UNKNOWN run.reconcile fence, retains conflicts, and blocks later prepare/adapter, claim/reclaim/release, execution-store, and step paths; a bare untrusted declaration remains unfenced. The cleanup partial-write matcher is limited to frozen C-step/role/floor/same-run cleanup state, leaves aggregate effects unknown and conflicts held, and still rejects malformed, duplicate, unmatched, and cross-run flows. Failure modes checked: capture-to-intent and cleanup-flow-to-terminal SIGKILL, live-owner races, late writers, same-key replay, and conflicting evidence. Edge cases checked: untrusted legacy rows, empty trusted runs, mixed NoFlow, two-object cleanup, replay and concurrent reconciliation. Rollback remains transactional with conflicts retained on unknown/error; monitoring is anchored by run.reconcile audit and rejection of later writes; input validation remains exact-run, exact capture, canonical request, floor/role/flow and workspace-scope bound. All eleven supplied repair hashes matched; independent focused offline reruns passed 4/4. The pinned Investigation executable remains unavailable, but deterministic static/offline evidence is sufficient for this passive recovery change; no target traffic was used.
